home.title: Home
home.empty_message: Turn on a module in the catalog to see it here.
home.reorder_hint: Long-press a card to change the order.

catalog.title: Modules
catalog.description: Turn modules on or off. Turning one off keeps its data.
catalog.failed: On, but it could not be started.

settings.title: Settings
settings.modules_description: Turn the app modules on or off.

guard.plugin_disabled: That module is turned off. Turn it on in the catalog to use it.
guard.plugin_unavailable: That module is not available right now.

sync.tile_description: Share the data with the other phones at home over WiFi.
sync.title: Sync

status.no_household_message: Create a household or join one to share the data with other devices.
status.error_transport: Couldn't connect to the other device. Check that both are on the same WiFi with the app open.
status.error_authentication: The other device doesn't have the household's current key. It may need to scan the code again.
status.error_protocol: The other device uses another version of the app. Update both.
status.error_unknown: Something went wrong while syncing. It will try again.

household.show_code_description: Scan it from the other device.
household.no_devices: It hasn't synced with any other device yet.
household.creator: You created this household
household.expel_message: The household gets a new key. “{name}” keeps the data it already has but won't receive anything new. The other devices will have to scan the code again.
household.expelled: New key. The other devices must scan this code.
household.leave_message: This device will stop syncing. The data it already has is kept.
household.error_already_in_household: This device is already in another household. Leave it before joining a new one.
household.error_not_creator: Only the device that created the household can remove others.
household.error_generic: Couldn't complete the action. Try again.

invitation.title: Household code
invitation.qr_label: QR code to join the household
invitation.message: Scan it from the other device in “Settings → Sync → Join a household”.
invitation.warning: Whoever scans this code can see and change the household's data. Only show it to your people.
invitation.code_label: Or share it and paste it on the other device:

join.title: Join a household
join.scan_prompt: Point the camera at the household code shown on the other device.
join.camera_unavailable: The camera isn't available. Paste the household code.
join.camera_denied: No camera permission. Paste the household code or grant the permission in Settings.
join.invalid_code: That code isn't a household of this app.
join.joined: You joined the household. The data will be combined when syncing.

conflicts.title: Conflicts
conflicts.empty_message: When two devices change the same thing at once and a decision is needed, it shows up here.
conflicts.container_deleted_message: “{container}” was deleted while another device was putting “{item}” inside. “{item}” was left outside.
conflicts.move_reverted_message: Two devices moved items at once and “{item}” would have ended up inside itself or too deep. Its last move was undone.
conflicts.identifier_twice_message: The code “{value}” was linked to two items at once. It can only be on one.
conflicts.double_purchase_message: Two devices recorded buying “{name}” at the same time.
conflicts.unknown_message: Two devices changed the same thing at once.

spaces.title: Spaces
spaces.switch_message: The app starts again with that space's data and plugins.
spaces.delete_message: Its data is deleted from this device. If it is a household, the other devices keep theirs.
spaces.create_description: A separate set of data, only on this device.
spaces.notice_shared: You are now in “{name}”. It will catch up when it sees the household's other devices.
spaces.notice_failed: The space could not be opened. You are still in “{name}”.
spaces.bring_message: You can share this space's data with the household, or start a new, empty space for the household.
spaces.error_generic: The action could not be completed. Try again.
